questions.question: What are the peoples told to do in Psalm 47?
options: Bow down in deep silence and wait patiently upon the LORD
Clap their hands and shout to God with loud songs of joy
Weep aloud and mourn deeply for the sins of the people
Bring forward their offerings and faithfully pay their vows
questions.answer: Clap their hands and shout to God with loud songs of joy

questions.question: What does the psalm declare about God and the nations?
options: God freely forgives the sins of all those who are penitent
God reigns over the nations; he is king of all the earth
God hides his face entirely from the wicked and the proud
God remembers his ancient covenant made with Abraham
questions.answer: God reigns over the nations; he is king of all the earth

questions.question: God has gone up with a shout, the LORD with the sound of a trumpet.
How _____ is the LORD Most High, the great King over all the earth!
